international-trading.name: International Trading
international-trading.summary: Trading and agency support for international transactions in the product categories covered by the company's registered business scope.

import-export.name: Import & Export
import-export.summary: Import and export of goods, food included, and import and export agency, as listed in the company's registered business scope.

product-sourcing.name: Product Sourcing
product-sourcing.summary: Identifying products and suppliers that match a buyer's requirements in the registered product categories, as an activity that supports trade agency.

supplier-coordination.name: Supplier Coordination
supplier-coordination.summary: Coordinating communication between buyers and suppliers, from clarifying requirements to exchanging quotations, as an activity that supports trade agency.

business-procurement.name: Business Procurement
business-procurement.summary: Procurement support for business buyers who need goods within the registered product categories, carried out through trade agency and import and export.

cross-border-trade.name: Cross-Border Trade
cross-border-trade.summary: Trade in goods across borders through import and export agency and the import and export of goods, including internet sales of goods that do not require a license to sell.
